text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of Symboli Rudolf's races have been run. With seven crowns to her name, she has proven beyond all doubt that she is truly the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The weight hangs heavy, but she is strong enough to bear it. We both celebrate the fulfillment of our shared dream.
